text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Nigeria's central bank is scrutinising persons behind nine groups bidding to buy five distressed banks to ensure they are not drug barons or fraudsters, banking sources say.
- Cash-strapped pensioners of state electricity utility NEPA say they prefer cash handouts to end of year party thrown for them by management.
- Road safety commission says has concluded plans with army and police to arrest and prosecute motorists who fail to switch to new plate numbers by December 31 deadline.
